Currently the driver will try to protect all frames
which leads to a lot of odd things like sending an
RTS with a zeroed RA before multicast frames
is clearly bogus.
In order to fix all of this
column2: we need to take a step

column1: back and see what we need to achieve:
* we need RTS/CTS protection if requested by
the AP for the BSS
* in that case
enabled when mac80211 tells us
* additionally
some devices we have to protect aggregated
frames with RTS
To achieve the first two items
accordingly and set the protection required flag
in the transmit command when mac80211 requests
protection for the frame.
To achieve the last item
RTS-requested flag for all stations that we have
aggregation sessions with
required flag when sending aggregated frames (on
those devices where this is required).
Since otherwise bugs can occur
user to override the RTS-for-aggregation setting
from sysfs any more.
Finally
column2: also clean up the way all these flags get

column1: set in the driver and move everything into the
device-specific functions.
